_readme: Per-model licence verdicts for what the shop may SELL. Keys are model file names as ComfyUI lists them (a krea2: prefix is ignored; a * matches any text). commercial_use is yes, conditional, no or unverified. Working reference, not legal advice; the evidence and how to re-check each row live in the styleforge repo, docs/MODEL_LICENSES.md. Subject IP (a character or unit you draw) is separate from the model licence.

WAI-Nsfw-Illustrious-17.safetensors.licence: Civitai creator permissions: images may be sold, no credit needed
WAI-Nsfw-Illustrious-17.safetensors.note: Illustrious base licence restricts monetising closed-source models you train or merge from it, not the images you generate.

novaFurryXL_ilV140.safetensors.licence: Civitai creator permissions: images may be sold, no credit needed
novaFurryXL_ilV140.safetensors.note: A merge on the Illustrious base; same base-licence note as WAI.

divingIllustrious_nijiMutedColorVAE.safe.note: A merge of several third-party models and no source page was found. Keep it out of anything that is sold until it is checked by hand.

krea2_turbo_int8_convrot.safetensors.note: Allowed while trailing-12-month revenue is under USD 1M; other terms (seat limit, content filtering) are unconfirmed and this is a third-party int8 quantization whose own licence is unchecked.

wan2.2_*.note: Weights are reported Apache-2.0; the wording on who owns outputs is not confirmed. Read the official LICENSE before selling video.

wan2.1_fun_inp_1.3B*.note: Weights are reported Apache-2.0; the wording on who owns outputs is not confirmed.
